naam: Polsen draaien in achtjes – handen gevouwen
pose_en: He sits upright on a chair, seen from the front. Elbows bent about 90 degrees, both hands clasped together with interlaced fingers in front of his chest, wrists straight and knuckles pointing forward. One black arrow starts at the clasped hands and curves in a sideways figure-eight loop towards the viewer's left.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The clasped hands are tilted strongly towards the viewer's left: one wrist clearly bent, the other clearly extended, elbows still bent in front of the chest.

naam: Arm wrijven met je andere hand – zittend
pose_en: He sits upright on a chair, seen from the front, a cushion on his lap. His right forearm rests relaxed on the cushion, palm down. His left hand lies flat on the back of his right hand and he looks down at his right arm. One black arrow starts at the left hand and points along the right forearm up towards the right shoulder.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His left hand has slid all the way up the right arm and now rests flat on the outside of his right shoulder; the right arm still rests on the cushion, he still looks at the arm.

naam: Pols naar pinkzijde – met elastiek
pose_en: Close-up of forearm and hand, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). He sits at a table; his right forearm rests on the tabletop with the thumb pointing up (handshake position), the hand just past the table edge, wrist in line with the forearm. A resistance band is looped around the right hand and pulled up taut by his left hand held above it. One black arrow starts at the right knuckles and points straight down towards the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The right hand is tilted clearly downward at the wrist towards the little-finger side, fingers pointing diagonally to the floor; the forearm stays flat on the table and the band is stretched longer.

naam: Armen strekken boven je hoofd – vingers gevouwen
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart. Both arms hang down in front of his body with the fingers interlaced in front of his lower belly, palms facing his body. One black arrow starts at the clasped hands and points straight up, past his face to above his head.
eind_en: END position: same front view. Both arms are stretched straight up above his head, elbows fully extended, fingers still interlaced and the palms turned up towards the ceiling.

naam: Onderarm masseren – binnenkant, met je andere hand
pose_en: He sits upright on a chair, seen from the front, a cushion on his lap. His right forearm rests on the cushion with the palm facing up and the wrist straight. The flat fingertips of his left hand press on the inner side of the right forearm just below the elbow crease. One black arrow starts at the left fingertips and points along the inner forearm towards the right wrist.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The left fingertips have slid down the whole inner forearm and now press at the right wrist near the base of the thumb; the right palm still faces up on the cushion.

naam: Munten omdraaien op tafel
pose_en: Close-up of the hand on a table, seen from the front. He sits at a table with a row of five coins lying flat in front of him. His right forearm rests on the table, and the tips of his right thumb and index finger touch the edges of the first coin, which still lies flat. One black arrow starts at that coin and curves upward and over in a small flipping arc.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The right thumb and index finger hold the coin lifted a few centimetres above the table, the coin standing on its edge halfway through the flip; the other coins lie in the row.

naam: Opdrukken op de knieën – ellebogen langs het lichaam
pose_en: He is on hands and knees on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Hands flat on the floor directly under his shoulders, arms straight, knees under his hips, back flat and horizontal, eyes on the floor. One black arrow starts at his chest and points straight down to the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Both elbows are bent and point backwards close along his ribs, his chest is lowered to just above the floor between his hands, knees still on the mat and back straight.

naam: Lopen met een looprek
pose_en: He stands upright inside a four-legged walking frame, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Both hands hold the handgrips, elbows slightly bent, feet side by side between the rear legs of the frame, eyes looking ahead. One black arrow starts at his right foot and points forward along the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The frame stands a short step further forward; his right leg has stepped forward and the right heel touches the floor first, toes lifted, while the left foot is behind with the heel starting to rise. His trunk stays upright.

naam: Lopen met een wandelstok
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart. He holds a walking stick in his LEFT hand, the tip on the floor beside his left foot, the left elbow slightly bent; the right arm hangs relaxed. One black arrow starts at the tip of the stick and points forward towards the viewer.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The stick is placed one short step forward and his RIGHT foot has stepped forward level with the stick, right heel on the floor; the left foot is still behind and his trunk is upright.

naam: Opstaan van de vloer – met steun van een stoel
pose_en: He kneels on both knees on the floor in front of a sturdy chair, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). The chair seat faces him and both his hands rest on the front of the seat, arms almost straight, trunk upright. His right foot is already placed flat on the floor in front of him with the knee bent 90 degrees (half-kneeling). One black arrow starts at his hips and points diagonally up and forward.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He stands upright in front of the chair, both legs straight, feet hip-width apart, leaning slightly forward with both hands still resting lightly on the chair seat.

naam: Paperclips in een beker doen
pose_en: Close-up of the hand on a table, seen from the front. He sits at a table; a few paperclips lie on the tabletop and a cup stands next to them. The tips of his right thumb and index finger pinch one paperclip that still lies on the table. One black arrow starts at that paperclip and curves up and sideways to the opening of the cup.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right hand hovers directly above the cup, thumb and index finger holding the paperclip over the opening, ready to drop it; the remaining paperclips lie on the table.

naam: Overstappen van bed naar stoel – via je sterke kant
pose_en: He sits on the edge of a bed, seen from the front, both feet flat on the floor. A chair with armrests stands close to his right side, turned 90 degrees to the bed. He leans his trunk forward and his right hand grips the far armrest of the chair; the left hand rests on the bed. One black arrow starts at his hips and curves sideways towards the chair seat.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He now sits upright on the chair, back against the backrest, both feet flat on the floor and hands on the armrests; the empty bed edge is beside him.

naam: Deksel van een pot draaien
pose_en: He sits upright at a table, seen from the front. A glass jar with a screw lid stands on the table in front of him. His left hand grips the body of the jar, his right hand lies on top with the fingers and thumb wrapped around the lid. One black arrow starts at the lid and curves counter-clockwise around it.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The lid is off: his right hand holds the lid lifted about ten centimetres above the open jar, the wrist clearly rotated; the left hand still holds the jar on the table.

naam: Opdrukken tegen de muur
pose_en: He stands facing a wall, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), the wall at the right edge of the image. His feet are about one large step away from the wall, both palms flat on the wall at shoulder height, arms straight, body leaning slightly forward in one straight line from head to heels. One black arrow starts at his chest and points horizontally towards the wall.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Both elbows are bent, his chest and face are close to the wall, the body still in one straight line from head to heels, heels on the floor.

naam: Vinger achterover rekken – met je andere hand
pose_en: Close-up of both hands, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). He sits on a chair with a cushion on his lap; his right forearm rests on the cushion, palm down, wrist straight, fingers relaxed and flat. His left hand comes from below and holds the right middle finger between thumb and fingers. One black arrow starts at the tip of the right middle finger and points up and back towards his wrist.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The right middle finger is lifted straight and bent far backwards at the knuckle, pointing up at a steep angle, held by the left hand; the other fingers, palm and wrist stay flat on the cushion.

naam: Omrollen naar je zij – ruglig
pose_en: He lies on his back on a mat, seen from the side: we see his RIGHT side, his head at the viewer's left. His right leg (nearest to the viewer) is straight, his left knee is bent with the left foot flat on the mat, his left hand rests on his belly and his right arm lies on the mat slightly away from his body. One black arrow starts at his left knee and curves over his body towards the viewer.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He has rolled onto his right side and now faces the viewer: the left knee is bent and rests on the mat in front of him, the left arm reaches across with the hand on the mat in front of his chest, head turned to the viewer.

naam: Speelkaarten omdraaien – onderarm draaien
pose_en: He sits upright at a table, seen from the front. A few playing cards lie face down on the table. His right elbow is bent 90 degrees and tucked against his side; his right hand, palm facing down, pinches one card between thumb and fingers just above the table. One black arrow starts at the right hand and curves in a rotating arc outward, showing the forearm turning palm up.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The right forearm is fully rotated so the palm faces straight up to the ceiling, the card lying face up on his fingers and held by the thumb; the elbow is still bent 90 degrees against his side.

naam: Beker optillen en verplaatsen – zittend aan tafel
pose_en: He sits upright at a table, seen from the front. A plain cup stands on the table in front of his right shoulder. His right arm reaches forward, elbow slightly bent, and his right hand is wrapped around the cup; his left hand rests flat on the table. One black arrow starts at the cup and points horizontally across the table towards his left side (the viewer's right).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right arm has moved across in front of his body and holds the cup just above the table in front of his left shoulder; his trunk is still upright and both shoulders are level.

naam: Vingers strekken in therapieklei
pose_en: Close-up of the hand on a table, seen from the front and slightly from above. A flat round disc of therapy putty lies on the table. His right hand is above it with all five fingertips bunched together and pressed into the centre of the disc, fingers bent. One black arrow starts at the fingertips and points outward across the putty, away from the centre.
eind_en: END position: same view. The right hand is wide open: fingers and thumb fully straightened and spread far apart, flat on the table, with the putty stretched into a wider thin sheet under the fingertips.

naam: Vingers één voor één in therapieklei drukken
pose_en: Close-up of the hand on a table, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). A thick sausage-shaped roll of therapy putty lies on the table. His right hand hovers just above it, wrist straight, fingers slightly bent, the tip of the index finger just touching the top of the putty. One black arrow starts at the index fingertip and points straight down into the putty.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The right index finger is pressed deep into the putty, making a clear dent, while the thumb and the other three fingers stay lifted high above the roll.
